verdict.rationale: Ramp documents that employees can submit reimbursements (CLI `reimbursements submit`, and requesting reimbursements via MCP). It also states employees can be paid in two days or less in 70+ countries. A `reimbursements list/pending` surface and a 'paid' reimbursement state exist, but the payout rail and end-to-end status tracking are not described. Missing for 10: explicit direct-deposit/bank-transfer payout mechanism, documented submission-to-payout status tracking for employees, independent or hands-on corroboration of the two-day payout speed.

support.subject: As an employee, I can submit an out-of-pocket expense and get reimbursed by direct deposit in days, tracked from submission to payout

citations.quote: Reimburse employees with confidence in more than 70 countries and 40 currencies, knowing they can be paid in two days or less in their local currency.
employees can check balances, request reimbursements, or get policy answers directly from their daily tools
